description:
****IMPORTANT****

**********************

Customer Success Manager (CSM) – in Education

About Us

Our company is an established K-12 School with a global presence through strategic partnerships across multiple regions. We deliver comprehensive educational programs directly to students while also collaborating with institutional partners to broaden our reach and impact. As we continue our growth trajectory and enhance our operational capabilities, we're seeking passionate professionals who share our commitment to learner success and will help us build innovative, technology-enabled education solutions.

Job Overview

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the success of partner schools (B2B) and direct students (B2C) throughout the entire post-sales journey. You’ll own the relationship with schools and families after the sales handoff, orchestrating onboarding, adoption, support, and ongoing enablement across Customer Success, Training, and Support teams. As a key leader in our customer-facing organization, you’ll drive engagement, retention, and growth while ensuring our programs deliver measurable academic and experiential value for learners and partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding of B2B partner schools and B2C students with a high-touch approach, defining and monitoring success plans and ensuring complete training on processes, platforms (LMS), and methodologies to achieve rapid time-to-first-value.
  • Drive product adoption and customer health by tracking usage and engagement metrics, identifying risk signals, and leading QBRs/JBPs with school leadership to align goals, review results, and execute action plans.
  • Own student success motions by implementing early-alert rules, outreach cadences, and coaching/persistence tactics, and bringing learner outcomes and stories into value conversations with partners.
  • Coordinate the school visit strategy and staffing together with the Academic team, and act on visit feedback to continuously improve the customer experience.
  • Oversee LMS/SIS support operations based on structured workflows, ensuring fast and transparent incident resolution and maintaining a knowledge base that reduces repeat issues and feeds into training and product improvements.
  • Identify and qualify expansion (cross-sell and upsell) and renewal opportunities based on adoption, results, and satisfaction, partnering closely with Sales on pricing, negotiation, and closing.
  • Systematize the voice of the customer by consolidating insights from QBRs, support, and direct interactions, translating them into strategic inputs for Product, Instructional Design, and Technology, and coordinating enablement on new features and releases.
  • Manage sensitive and complex situations with schools and families, de-escalating conflicts and aligning on clear next steps while preserving trust and partnership.
  • Lead and integrate the Customer Success, Support, and Training teams to deliver a seamless, consistent customer success journey across all touchpoints.
  • Define, track, and report key success metrics (e.g., time-to-first-value, engagement and usage trends, support quality, and retention), ensuring accountability and continuous improvement across sub-teams.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in customer success, account management, operations, or related roles, preferably in education or EdTech, managing both B2B partners and B2C student journeys.
  • Proven experience leading customer-facing and cross-functional teams, including designing customer journeys and success plans that turn data and feedback into action.
  • Experience managing a small team (3–8 people), including goal-setting, feedback, and coaching.
  • Hands-on experience with LMS/SIS platforms and support/service desk operations; experience with structured support processes and knowledge base management (e.g., ITIL, KCS, or similar approaches is a plus).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to build high-trust relationships with school leadership, families, and internal teams across Sales, Academic, Product, Technology, and Operations.
  • Strong conflict management and negotiation skills, with experience handling escalations and difficult conversations with customers while maintaining trust and respect.
  • Strong analytical and process-oriented mindset, capable of interpreting adoption, engagement, and support metrics to design scalable workflows and drive continuous improvement.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ownership mindset with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach in a fast-growing environment.

What We Offer

  • A culture in a constantly growing segment with continuous learning opportunities.
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd's International programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model: 3+ days onsite Sao Paulo (Zona Sul) - Availability for travel nationwide.
  • Parking at our headquarters.
  • Compensation plan, consisting of a fixed monthly amount + bonus tied to goals, under a contract model (PJ legal entity).

If you're passionate about driving partner and student success, have a talent for building high-trust, data-informed relationships, and excel at orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver outcomes, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior Cybersecurity MSS/SOC Engineer - SIEM/SOAR
description:
A UPX é referência latino-americana em proteção de borda, observabilidade e Managed Security Services. Há mais de 22 anos, protegemos infraestruturas críticas e operações de alta disponibilidade. Estamos em busca de um engenheiro com experiência prática em Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM + SOAR) para integrar nosso time de engenharia e sustentar a operação 24×7 de detecção e resposta.

O desafio

  1. Conduzir o onboarding de novos clientes na plataforma Google SecOps, garantindo ingestão, parsing e normalização de dados via forwarders, parsers, conectores e APIs.
  2. Desenvolver regras de detecção de alta precisão usando YARA-L e MITRE ATT&CK, reduzindo falsos positivos e otimizando o ciclo de resposta.
  3. Criar e manter playbooks automatizados de resposta (SOAR) que suportem casos de uso críticos e melhorem métricas de MTTC e MTTR.
  4. Elaborar dashboards, relatórios e painéis executivos para clientes e operações internas.
  5. Apoiar o time de SOC em atividades de triagem, investigação e resposta a incidentes.
  6. Integrar a plataforma a soluções de telemetria (EDR, WAF, Cloud, Network, IAM etc.) e ferramentas internas (ITSM, CTI, Threat Intel).
  7. Atuar na melhoria contínua de detecção, runbooks e processos operacionais, alinhando-se às práticas MITRE ATT&CK e NIST CSF.

Perfil obrigatório

  • Nível Pleno ou Sênior (não se trata de uma posição N1 ou junior)
  • Atuação mínima de 2 anos (pleno) ou 4 anos (sênior) em cibersegurança dentro de operações SOC/MSS (detecção, resposta e automação).
  • Domínio comprovado com Google Chronicle SecOps. 
  • Conhecimento sólido em engenharia de detecção, tuning, MITRE ATT&CK e resposta a incidentes.
  • Experiência na criação de playbooks e runbooks operacionais.
  • Capacidade analítica, disciplina na documentação e perfil totalmente hands-on.

Diferenciais valorizados

  • Certificação Google Professional Security Operations Engineer.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, Elastic, Azure Sentinel, QRadar etc) e tecnologias de monitoramento de cibersegurança correlatas.
  • Certificações MITRE ATT&CK Defender, CompTIA Security+, GSEC, ou equivalentes.
  • Vivência com plataformas de Threat Intelligence.
  • Habilidade em Python, PowerShell ou linguagens usadas em automação de segurança.
  • Inglês técnico intermediário (leitura e reuniões ocasionais).

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente de engenharia hardcore, com laboratório dedicado e acesso a Chronicle em escala de petabytes.
  • Participação em decisões de arquitetura que impactam operações de larga escala em setores críticos.
  • Time sênior, cultura de peer-review e exposição direta ao C-level.
  • Trilha de carreira técnica transparente com metas claras.

title: Gerente Funcional Elétrica e Instrumentação Recuperação
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Objetivo geral do cargo:

Conduzir o time de Elétrica e Instrumentação, coordenando e alinhando as demandas de otimização da manutenção dos sistemas elétricos, de instrumentação e de automação industrial, nas áreas do Preparo de Madeiras, Linhas de Fibras e Secagem, supervisionando a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva dos ativos, assegurando que os equipamentos operem de forma otimizada e com o menor tempo de inatividade possível, contribuindo para os resultados e atingimento da meta de produção de celulose, com segurança e custos adequados.

Atividades Principais:

  • Garantir que todo o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizar ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias;
  • Realizar a gestão da manutenção Elétrica e Instrumentação, planejando e coordenando a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos elétricos e instrumentados da planta, reduzindo o risco de falhas e paradas imprevistas, garantindo a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos sistemas;
  • Coordenar o time nas atividades de manutenção dos sistemas elétricos da planta, incluindo turbogeradores, precipitador eletrostático, subestações, painéis elétricos e redes de distribuição de energia, suportar tecnicamente a equipe;
  • Gerenciar a manutenção de todos os instrumentos de medição e controle de processos (pressão, temperatura, nível, fluxo etc.), assegurando que estejam calibrados e funcionando corretamente, garantindo a calibração periódica dos instrumentos, de acordo com as normas e especificações técnicas, para assegurar a precisão e qualidade dos processos;
  • Coordenar a manutenção dos sistemas, incluindo CLPs (Controladores Lógicos Programáveis), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) e DCS (Sistemas de Controle Distribuído), garantindo a operação contínua e eficiente dos sistemas automatizados que controlam os processos de produção, otimização de energia e gestão de dados em tempo real;
  • Proporcionar interação com outras áreas, como produção, qualidade e melhoria contínua, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam em plena capacidade de e alinhados com as metas operacionais, bem como, participar de reuniões estratégicas para apoiar decisões sobre melhorias de processos e investimentos em novos equipamentos;
  • Realizar a gestão do seu time, alinhando segurança, qualidade, produtividade e custos, promovendo o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, oferecendo orientação e suporte;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.

Requisitos do Cargo

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação e/ou áreas correlatas
  • Desejável Especialização em Manutenção Industrial, Gestão de Projetos, Especialização Celulose, Lean Manufacturing e afins

Experiência:

  • Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção em válvulas automáticas e de controle;
  • Conhecimento em Instrumentação Convencional e Analítica, manutenção em analisadores de acordo com as variáveis de Processo;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas dedicados, drives, inversores e disjuntores de MT (média tensão) e BT (baixa tensão);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas preditivas elétricas.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.

Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation

For more information, you may check our website：

Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.

Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)

Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.

Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: SAP Functional SD Consultant
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for a SAP SD Consultant to join our team in Brazil.

Work Location: Onsite at Project location.

About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.

Required skills and experience

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.

Required skills and experience

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior para atuar em parceria com um cliente do segmento de seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Avaliação de Ameaças e Riscos: Identificar e avaliar as ameaças e riscos de segurança durante a implementação dos projetos de negócio, garantindo que todos os aspectos críticos sejam analisados e mitigados.

- Definição de Requisitos de Segurança : Definir os requisitos necessários para garantir um nível adequado de segurança da informação em todos os componentes dos projetos, assegurando a conformidade com as políticas de segurança da empresa.

- Acompanhamento de Projetos : Monitorar o desenvolvimento dos projetos, garantindo que os requisitos de segurança sejam seguidos e que o progresso atenda às expectativas e metas estabelecidas.

- Verificação de Aderência : Avaliar a aderência dos projetos aos requisitos de segurança da informação e aos componentes necessários para mitigar riscos e garantir a proteção dos dados e sistemas.

- Relatórios de Não-Conformidades e Débitos Técnicos: Identificar, reportar e acompanhar as não-conformidades e débitos técnicos dos projetos relacionados à segurança cibernética, garantindo que as ações corretivas sejam implementadas.

- Avaliação de Riscos de Fornecedores e Soluções : Realizar a avaliação de riscos associados a fornecedores e analisar soluções de segurança para garantir que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela organização.

- Análises e Melhorias de Processos de Segurança : Conduzir análises contínuas e implementar melhorias nos processos de segurança, buscando sempre otimizar a proteção e reduzir vulnerabilidades.

- Garantia de Proteção nos Produtos e Processos : Ter uma visão holística dos produtos e processos da vertical, assegurando que estejam adequadamente protegidos com as ferramentas e práticas de segurança da informação.

- Assessoria em Processos de Negócio : Oferecer assessoria nas áreas de negócios, identificando oportunidades de melhoria, mitigação de riscos, correção de falhas na execução de processos e cobertura de riscos não abordados em relação à Tecnologia da Informação.

- Orientação sobre a Esteira de Segurança : Orientar as equipes sobre a utilização correta da esteira de segurança, promovendo boas práticas e garantindo a conformidade com os protocolos estabelecidos.

Requisitos e qualificações

- Ensino Superior Completo;

- Conhecimento dos principais frameworks de segurança e proteção de dados (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, PCI DSS);

- Conhecimento em Modelagem de ameaças e riscos.

- Conhecimento de proteção de dados, criptografia, soluções de segurança da informação. (Ex: IPS, UTM, WAF, Proxy, Antivírus, VPN, SIEM, Proteção DDoS, DLP, NAC, Prisma Cloud);

- Experiência em projetos de segurança da informação;

- Experiência em avaliação de riscos cibernéticos em projetos;

- Elaboração de Apresentação de indicadores e relatórios de vulnerabilidades;

- Experiência em melhoria contínua relacionado a Segurança da Informação;

- Conhecimento em infraestrutura de TI (Datacenter, Infraestrutura, Telecom, Firewall, Clouds: AWS, GCP ou Azure, Cisco Umbrella);

- Conhecimento em SOC, CSIRT e Hunting.

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities：

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.

Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.

At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.

Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.

Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.

Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.

Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.

Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.

Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Portuguese and English, for effective communication is preferred.

Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

title: User Acquisition Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Overview

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven professional to lead new user engagement initiatives through targeted segmentation and optimized incentive strategies. This role plays a key part in driving user growth and conversion across digital platforms, with a strong focus on performance analysis, experimentation, and cross-functional execution.

Job Responsabilities

Strategy and Planning

  • Develop annual and quarterly goals and operational plans for new user conversion.
  • Design differentiated conversion strategies based on user registration source, region, and timing.
  • Create incentive schemes such as first-order discounts, limited-time subsidies, and combo packages, and ensure their effective implementation.

Campaign Planning and Execution

  • Plan exclusive campaigns for new users, such as first-order discounts, first-week offers, and welcome bonuses.
  • Incorporate holiday promotions into marketing campaigns.
  • Coordinate with design, product, marketing, and merchant operations teams to ensure timely campaign launches and optimized user experience.

Data Analysis and Optimization

  • Monitor core metrics related to new user conversion (registration-to-first-order rate, first-order cost, early retention, etc.).
  • Conduct post-campaign reviews, analyze user behavior paths, and identify conversion bottlenecks.
  • Adjust strategies quickly based on data insights and continuously optimize performance.

User Insights and Segmentation

  • Analyze new users’ characteristics based on source, preferences, and purchasing power.
  • Develop refined segmentation-based operational plans to improve conversion efficiency across different user segments.
  • Continuously iterate segmentation logic based on market competition and user feedback.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher; preferred majors include engineering, business, or related fields.
  • Fluent in English, with proven ability to communicate effectively across international teams.
  • Experience in traffic operations, content distribution, growth product management, or similar roles within internet platforms.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, or local life services platforms is preferred; experience with local services platforms is a strong plus.
  • Overseas experience in internet product roles is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with in-platform resource management logic and a systematic understanding of user growth funnels.
  • Proficient in data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, BI platforms), with strong data sensitivity and analytical thinking.
  • Hands-on experience with traffic distribution strategies, content efficiency evaluation, and A/B testing design.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and project management skills; results-oriented with excellent execution capability.

We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. title: Repórter Investigativo de Política
description:
Sobre o Bastidor

Somos um veículo criado por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um repórter investigativo para cobrir, majoritariamente, Congresso Nacional. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de Câmara e Senado envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações políticas quanto acompanhamento crítico e fiscalizador de assuntos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, priorizar e explicar pautas de alto impacto (plenário e comissões).
  • Ler e interpretar pareceres, relatórios, emendas, LOA/LDO, diários e atas.
  • Construir e preservar fontes (lideranças, relatorias, consultorias, assessorias, mercado) com ética.
  • Investigar trilhas documentais (Portal da Transparência, ComprasGov, e‑SIC/LAI, TCU).
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração (entrevista, checagem, leitura de documentos).
  • Conhecimento básico do Legislativo brasileiro (regimento, tramitação, orçamento).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Vivência em Brasília/legislativo; leitura avançada de regimento.
  • Noções de dados (limpeza, cruzamento) e/ou Python/SQL.
  • Inglês de leitura.

O que você aprenderá no Bastidor

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.

Como se candidatar

Pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para com "Repórter Investigativo de Política" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments

  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)

Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms .   • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .

  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.

Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement , are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

At Avenues, science project teachers work closely with colleagues to design and enact interdisciplinary learning experiences as part of a teaching team within a grade level. In their role as part of a project team, teachers ensure that students act as scientists every day: asking questions, conducting experiments, and learning deeply from the world around them. :

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to design interdisciplinary projects and continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Science teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A burning desire to work as part of a project-based, interdisciplinary team

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in general physical and life sciences, as well as one or more specialized topics (e.g. astronomy, environmental science, engineering, etc.)

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching science, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Software QA Engineer

Location: Brazil Fully Remote

Reports To: Head of QA/ Engineering Manager

Setup: Consultancy/PJ

Must Have: English Resume and Professional level of English Communication Skills

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Sr QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing. This role is critical to ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and user experience. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and champion quality across the entire software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and potential risks.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance scenarios.
  • Perform manual testing for exploratory, usability, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Test Automation
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and regression).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback.
  • Monitor and maintain test results, ensuring failures are triaged quickly.
  • Defect Tracking & Reporting
  • Log, prioritize, and track defects using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure Linear).
  • Partner with developers to reproduce, debug, and verify fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on test coverage, pass/fail rates, and quality trends.
  • Quality Advocacy
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to identify potential issues early.
  • Suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency and prevent defects.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar .
  • Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman , REST Assured, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, high-performing engineering team that values quality at every step.
  • Opportunity to shape and improve our test automation strategy and quality processes.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

A Hexagon (Nasdaq Estocolmo: HEXA B) tem aproximadamente 24.000 funcionários em 50 países e vendas líquidas de aproximadamente US$ 5,5 bilhões. Saiba mais em hexagon.com e siga-nos em @HexagonAB.

Como Arquiteto de Soluções com foco no setor de transporte de mineração, você trabalhará sob a supervisão do nosso Arquiteto de Soluções Principal. Você terá um papel crucial na criação e no gerenciamento de soluções complexas e inovadoras para atender às necessidades de nossos clientes em nossa área de gestão de frotas. Essa função exige conhecimento profundo tanto de TO (tecnologia operacional) quanto de TI (tecnologia da informação), além de experiência sólida na definição/análise de requisitos, no projeto de soluções escaláveis e seguras, no trabalho com equipes multifuncionais e na integração de sistemas.

Principais áreas de responsabilidade:

  • Trabalhar com clientes e stakeholders internos (incluindo especialistas em transporte rodoviário) para entender suas necessidades de negócios e transformá-las em soluções técnicas completas. Criar arquiteturas de soluções seguras e observáveis que abranjam questões de software, hardware, infraestrutura de dados, integração e infraestrutura.
  • Atuar como ponte entre o negócio e a tecnologia em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do produto e do projeto. Orientar e liderar técnicos as equipes de desenvolvimento, garantindo que sigam as melhores práticas, os padrões do setor, os padrões atualizados e as proteções.
  • Seja especialista em tecnologias para transporte de minérios. Acompanhe os últimos desenvolvimentos na área e usos para projetar soluções criativas e eficazes.
  • Trabalhe com equipes de desenvolvimento para conectar nossas soluções de gestão de frotas a plataformas e sistemas existentes. Crie interfaces, APIs e fluxos de trabalho de dados para facilitar a comunicação e a transferência de dados.
  • Analise sobreposições entre nossos produtos de gerenciamento de frotas e sugira possíveis maneiras de integrá-los em uma solução unificada.
  • Rever os processos de implantação e definir um roteiro para alinhar as melhores práticas da empresa.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes (internos e externos), atuando como consultores de confiança. Em alguns lugares pode até ser, mas aqui, no Banco Daycoval, existe um clima diferente!

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. title: Operation Strategy
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategy Formulation: Based on the characteristics of SMB and SAKA business structures, clarify strategies around different dimensions such as merchant basic information, review, and menus; identify key indicators, key initiatives, and implementation paths to ensure strategy feasibility.
  2. Strategy Implementation: Transform strategies into practical approaches suitable for frontline teams, rationally break down objectives, assign them to specific individuals and actions; coordinate resources to resolve key bottlenecks, ensuring strategies truly drive team members to achieve business goals. Coordinate and resolve cross-departmental collaboration and execution obstacles to ensure efficient implementation and a closed-loop process at each key stage.
  3. Strategy Evaluation and Iteration: Evaluate strategy effectiveness through data review and performance evaluation; propose adjustments to inefficient processes, forming a closed-loop strategy iteration system to continuously optimize city-level business.
  4. Resource and Tool Development: Develop SOPs for the entire business process. Create exclusive sales scripts, brand service reports, and case studies for chain merchants, forming replicable and efficient signing and closing strategies.
  5. Performance Scheme Development: Utilize data as a management tool to participate in the development of performance evaluation schemes for each module. Performance and incentives: Address sales momentum. Based on the goals at different stages, design new contract performance and incentive programs to stimulate sales momentum and drive efficient achievement of targets.

Job Requirements

  1. Education Background: Bachelor's degree or above.
  2. Work Experience: (Hard Requirements) At least 3 years of relevant work experience in the internet industry; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with sales processes and rhythms, experience in strategy development and incentive mechanism design; experience in e-commerce or food delivery industry is preferred.
  3. Skills and Analytical Abilities: Possess clear logical thinking ability; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with SQL and common business analysis methods, strong data sensitivity, and ability to independently analyze business problems and propose optimization suggestions.
  4. Project Management Ability: Ability to independently manage projects from initiation to completion.
  5. Collaboration Ability: Ability to efficiently coordinate internal and external teams, drive the execution of complex projects, and ensure timely completion of tasks.
  6. Language Requirements: (Hard Requirements) English CET-6 or above. A strong command of English is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Seus desafios no jogo:

• Desenhar e executar a estratégia de marketing e trade da categoria de Esportes, fortalecendo a conexão entre Centauro e o universo esportivo multiesporte;

• Gerenciar o plano 360° de campanhas e ativações, integrando frentes de comunicação, trade marketing, mídia, Visual Merchandising e experiências ;

• Cocriar lançamentos e campanhas em parceria com grandes marcas esportivas do mercado;

• Trabalhar de forma transversal e colaborativa com times de mídia, conteúdo, e-commerce, comercial, abastecimento, lojas e agências parceiras , garantindo consistência e qualidade nas entregas;

• Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, como crescimento de vendas, share de categoria e percepção de marca, traduzindo resultados em aprendizados e oportunidades de melhoria;

• Atuar com gestão de budget, assegurando o melhor uso dos recursos e a eficiência dos investimentos de marketing.

O que esperamos de você:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência prévia em projetos, ativações ou eventos — idealmente no segmento esportivo, varejo ou bens de consumo;

• Conhecimento prático de marketing 360°, com visão de integração entre trade, mídia, comunicação e experiência de marca;

• Experiência na gestão de agências e fornecedores, com foco em qualidade, prazos e controle orçamentário;

• Perfil organizado, colaborativo e executor, com habilidade para atuar em múltiplas frentes e construir relações de confiança com stakeholders internos e externos;

• Paixão genuína por esportes — independente da modalidade — e vontade de transformar essa energia em projetos inspiradores.

Diferenciais que contam ponto no jogo:

• Vivência anterior em marca esportiva, varejo esportivo, indústria de bens de consumo ou agência de marketing esportivo;

• Experiência em campanhas de trade, ativações e eventos esportivos;

• Pós-graduação ou especialização em Marketing Esportivo, Branding ou Comunicação Integrada;

• Familiaridade com indicadores de performance, ROI e métricas de awareness e engajamento.

⚙️ Competências que fazem a diferença:

• Foco em execução e excelência: garante entregas de ponta a ponta com qualidade e atenção aos detalhes;

• Colaboração e influência: atua de forma transversal, engajando parceiros internos e externos em torno dos mesmos objetivos;

• Visão de negócio e cliente: entende o consumidor esportivo e transforma dados e comportamento em ações práticas e relevantes;

• Paixão por esporte e autenticidade: vive o universo esportivo e traduz essa conexão em campanhas e experiências que inspiram e engajam.

O que você encontra por aqui:

• Um time que respira esporte e acredita no poder das experiências para conectar pessoas;

• Um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e cheio de oportunidades para inovar;

• Liberdade para criar, testar e evoluir ideias que fortalecem a marca Centauro;

• Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e protagonismo profissional.

title: SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and execute test concepts, automated or manual test script for cross platform mobile app SAP Service and Asset Manager and foundation framework Mobile Development Kit for Windows.

Follow SAP’s software quality standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in automation development and testing for mobile applications, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, with Behavior Driven Development, Java, JMeter, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system, Jenkins etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to clarify UI Figma design requirement for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows.

Document test concept, automation processes, test cases and workflows for reference and future improvement.

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to clarify OData Service features and requirement, to ensure sufficient test coverage.

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, with strong focus on usability, user experience, security, performance and feature correctness. Actively collaborate with frontend and backend developers to report functional issues, crashes, and performance problems, and validate fixes and resolution as required. Ensure test plant and results are maintained in the central Global Test Platform system for reporting and traceability.

Provide sufficient documentations on test environment, test results, re-produce steps

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) on any product documentation issues

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Maintain communication and documentation in English. Maintain proper communication and notification with SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Territory: Latin America

About the Role

We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.

Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).

Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst for Free Fire who will be responsible to lead high-impact marketing campaigns and special projects with autonomy and ownership. This role combines strategic thinking with creativity in a fast-paced, project-based environment where no two days are the same. Ideal for candidates who thrive amid ambiguity, take initiative, and are eager to grow quickly by solving meaningful challenges.

If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Planning: Develop end-to-end marketing campaign plans that align with the overall marketing strategy, grounded in clear rationale and player insights, and bring new innovative ideas.
  • Project Management: Lead campaign execution as project manager, ensuring cross-functional coordination with local teams, global stakeholders, and external partners to ensure high-quality, on-time deliverables.
  • Performance Analysis: Evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI of marketing levers to inform future planning and optimize spend.
  • Player & Product Insight: Develop a deep understanding of the game and its community to bridge global marketing initiatives with authentic, locally relevant insights.
  • Special Projects: Tackle high-priority initiatives to drive innovation and improve team efficiency, often in unstructured or ambiguous problem spaces.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from other disciplines with relevant experience or skills are also encouraged to apply;
  • Experience: Solid experience working with product marketing, brand management, strategic planning, management consulting, or leadership development programs. Demonstrated experience in project-based, strategic environments and case competitions is a strong plus;
  • Passion for Gaming: Must be an active gamer and regular consumer of gaming-related content;
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken;
  • Specific tool skills: Proficient in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, basic analysis);
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.

title: Assistente fiscal
description:
A Daiso é uma rede japonesa de "lojas de variedades", originalmente fundada em 1972. A marca oferece uma ampla seleção de produtos — mais de 70 mil itens no mundo todo — que vão desde utensílios domésticos e papelaria até cosméticos, alimentos e artigos sazonais.

Com mais de 3.620 lojas no Japão e cerca de 2.300 no exterior (totalizando mais de 5.900 globalmente), a Daiso consolidou sua presença no varejo em 28 países, incluindo o Brasil, os Estados Unidos e diversos mercados asiáticos. Presente no Brasil desde 2012, a marca já conta com cerca de 75 lojas espalhadas por cidades como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Curitiba, Brasília, Belo Horizonte, Florianópolis, Belém e Petrópolis.

Estamos procurando um(a) Auxiliar Fiscal para trabalhar no escritório da Daiso em São Paulo.

Responsabilidades

  • Lançamento, conferência e escrituração de NFE, CTE, Notas Serviço Tomados e emissõa de notas de saídas.
  • Análise de tributação (ICMS, ICMS/ST, FUNDO DE POBREZA, PAUTA FISCAL, MONOFÁSICO, IPI, PIS, COFINS).
  • Apuração e conciliação de impostos (ICMS, ICMS/ST, DIFAL, FUNDO POBREZA e ISS).
  • Elaboração e conferência de guias de recolhimento (ICMS e ICMS DIFAL EC 87/2015).
  • Suporte em obrigações acessórias (EFD-ICMS/IPI, GIA ST e GIA SP).
  • Parametrização e revisão de cadastros fiscais (Protheus).
  • Apoio em fiscalizações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhamento da legislação tributária.
  • Suporte fiscal ao time contábil e financeiro.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com o sistema Protheus (TOTVS) – módulo fiscal, compras e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento sólido em tributação de produtos para revenda.
  • Vivência com escrituração fiscal de NF-e e NFS-e.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e boa capacidade de análise.
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação interpessoal.

title: Quality Assurance Developer
description:
BASIC PURPOSE: Audits and tests enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract Transformation & Load) processes and other software modules as it pertains to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments in order to ensure high quality and integrity of the information. Creates ad-hoc queries to pull information from reporting sources as requested by the business areas.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Follow established quality assurance standards and processes.

Determine methods, flows, and procedures for better quality assurance and business processes.

Create and documents test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.

Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and determining whether the delivered product meets the required business requirements.

Analyze and resolve application and data issue problems as these arise.

Document production processes and objects to allow for a better understanding for both the IT team as well as the user community.

Handle ad-hoc queries from the data warehouse for the end users as needed.

Perform other job related functions as assigned.

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in a technical, MIS or related business degree from an accredited institution of study; or any equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

EXPERIENCE: Minimum of 2 years of data quality assurance experience, preferably in data warehousing or reporting.

2 years experience in quality assurance testing, preferably in the area of data integrity assessment. Preferably have at least 2 or more years of travel industry experience. Experienced working in a fast paced environment where shifting priorities are common.

title: Consultor de Vendas - Loja Física São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos:

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada cliente como uma oportunidade única de encantamento. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia na loja, buscando atingir suas metas, e a criatividade para criar experiências memoráveis para o consumidor, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa o perfil do cliente para fundamentar decisões criativas na venda.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo da loja (metas, estoque, cliente) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente sobre novos rótulos e se reinventa conforme o fluxo de clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes).
  • Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.

Descrição do Cargo:

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas é a pessoa fundamental para conectar nosso portfólio de vinhos ao cliente final. Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento consultivo de excelência, identificando o perfil de gosto, ocasião e orçamento de cada cliente.
  • Analisar o perfil do cliente e apresentar os vinhos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença na sua experiência.
  • Apoiar ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes na loja, assim como realizar "follow up" e pós-venda para clientes cadastrados.
  • Acompanhar as metas de vendas individuais e da loja (resultados, positivações) e propor ações para atingi-las.
  • Organizar e acompanhar degustações, "mini feiras" e eventos na loja, analisando o retorno de cada ação.
  • Garantir a organização do salão de vendas, incluindo reposição de produtos, precificação e Visual Merchandising.
  • Manter-se informado sobre todas as comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços, promoções e novas tabelas de trabalho.
  • Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia.
  • Apoiar no uso do sistema interno de faturamento da loja, CRM e no cadastro de clientes.

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa ou curso técnico.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos (técnico ou de extensão) é um forte diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês e/ou espanhol (para atendimento a clientes estrangeiros).
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de dois anos em atendimento ao cliente e vendas(varejo).
  • Desejável: Experiência prévia no setor de vinhos (lojas, empórios, restaurantes).

Remuneração:

Por que trabalhar na SEW?

title: Manager, Paperboard Sales (Americas), APRIL
description:
About APRIL

Asia Pacific Resources International Limited (APRIL) Group is one of the world’s leading producers of pulp and paper, known for technological excellence, efficiency, and sustainable forest management. Our flagship PaperOne™ brand and other products are used daily in packaging, printing, and writing applications, and sold in over 70 countries. With operations in Riau Province, Sumatra, Indonesia, APRIL employs around 9,000 people directly and supports more than 90,000 livelihoods through its wider ecosystem, contributing to sustainable growth and community development.

More details of APRIL at:

About the Role

Paperboard Sales Manager (Americas) will develop APRIL’s commercial growth across North and Latin American markets. The role focuses on executing sales plans, developing customer accounts, and expanding APRIL’s market footprint for its paperboard products. Working closely with the regional and global sales teams, the incumbent will drive day-to-day sales activities, monitor market trends, and strengthen customer relationships to achieve sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Market Development

  • Responsible for sales activities and achievement of sales targets for the paperboard business.
  • Implement regional sales plans and achieve volume, revenue, and margin targets.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across assigned markets.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, distributors, and channel partners.

Account Management & Customer Service

  • Manage assigned key accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order fulfilment, delivery, and payment collection.
  • Support resolution of customer issues and service improvement initiatives.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Track market trends, competitor activity, and pricing movements.
  • Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and insights to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align market insights with business priorities.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution.
  • Support regional marketing or promotional initiatives to strengthen brand presence.
  • Participate in trade shows, customer visits, and business reviews as required.

Job Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or Science; MBA preferred.
  • 6–10 years of sales experience in the paperboard, packaging, or related materials industry .
  • Experience in managing customer accounts across North or Latin America.
  • Strong communication skills in English; proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Sales and account management capability.
  • Strong commercial acumen and pricing awareness.
  • Negotiation and customer-engagement skills.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to interpret market data.
  • Collaboration across multicultural teams.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a dynamic environment.

Personal Characteristics

  • Results-oriented and self-driven, with high ownership and accountability.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust-based relationships.
  • Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced, multicultural environments.
  • High integrity, professionalism, and alignment with RGE’s values and sustainability principles.

We believe that bringing the right talent, technology, and organizations together helps unlock transformative outcomes and achieve new levels of success for the clients we serve and the consultants we hire.

Brazilian Time (BRT) from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m . This schedule was chosen to allow for more hours of interaction with the team working in Central European Time (CET).
